camera.reason: Single 50MP main camera without OIS and an 8MP selfie camera.

performance.reason: Helio G100 Ultimate is smooth in daily use and light gaming.

battery.reason: 6,000mAh with 45W charging lasts a full day plus and reaches 50% in about 25 minutes.

display.reason: HD+ IPS LCD at 120Hz with only 700 nits in high brightness mode.

build.reason: Plastic body with IP65 water jet resistance and a 1.5m drop rating.

software.reason: GSMArena and WhatMobile list up to 3 major Android upgrades from Android 16.

value.reason: Cheapest phone in the bracket at 63,000 with a big battery, NFC and a jack, but the HD+ LCD lags AMOLED rivals.

availability.reason: In stock in four colours at PriceOye with official Infinix warranty.

notes: Pakistan sells the 6GB 128GB only. Only PriceOye was checked for stock. Security patch years are not published for the Hot 70; 3 years is an assumption.
